opportunities.name: Research paper lookup and note (arXiv → Semantic Scholar → Notes)
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic in a specific year, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, then save a summary note.
steps: Enter search term, tick the date filter, choose specific year and enter YYYY
Click Search and open the first result
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the paper
Read first author and citation count

opportunities.name: Supreme Court case lookup with statute and note
opportunities.description: Find a case on CourtListener, open it, look up the related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: On CourtListener open Case Law > Search Case Law
Search the case name and open the matching result
Note the citation and decision date
On Cornell LII search the statute citation and open the section
